recipes.name: Foil-parcel peri-peri chicken
recipes.summary: One tray, one bowl, one knife cut. Chicken on frozen veg with peri-peri sauce, sealed in foil and baked, with microwave rice cups.

ingredients.item: Birds Eye Steamfresh baby potatoes & veg

method: Line a tray with foil and tip the veg out of its steam bag(s) onto it.
Lay the chicken on top. Slice any fillet thicker than ~3 cm open like a book.
Season, then drizzle the peri-peri over the chicken. Hot sauce goes a long way; a squirt of tomato sauce softens it.
Cover with a second sheet of foil, leave a little air gap, and crimp the edges shut.
Bake 20–25 minutes for thin fillets (30–35 for thick). Optional: cheese on top for the last 5 minutes.
Check the thickest overlapping piece is white all the way through with clear juice; if not, 5 more minutes.
Microwave the rice cups while it rests, then plate.
tips: Packs often come bigger than one serve: cook ~600 g and keep the rest in the fridge (or freeze it) for the next day.
Don't leave the oven running while out of the house; cook, check, then go.
Preheat the oven fully before the parcel goes in. Without a preheat, add about 10 minutes.
For a thick breast, butterfly it and then cut along the fold into two thin pieces, so it cooks evenly in 20–25 minutes.
Cheese can go on at the start if the foil stays sealed; it just melts. Uncover for the last 2–3 minutes to brown it.

variations.name: As written
variations.changes: 600 g chicken, one bag of veg, hot peri-peri, 2 rice cups; no oil or cheese.

variations.name: No rice
variations.changes: Same as written but without the rice cups (none at home).

variations.name: 500 g, double veg, protein rice, cheese
variations.changes: ~500 g chicken (butterflied, then cut up to finish cooking), 2 steam bags of veg, 2 SunRice protein rice cups, ~30 g cheese on top. A big plate: a little was left over.

variations.name: 500 g, one veg bag, one protein rice cup
variations.changes: ~500 g chicken, 1 steam bag of veg, 1 SunRice protein rice cup; no cheese.

recipes.name: Tuna rice bowl
recipes.summary: A 10-minute cupboard dinner: microwave rice cup, a steam bag of veg and drained tinned tuna, with cheese melted on top. No real cooking.

ingredients.item: Birds Eye Steamfresh baby potatoes & veg
Soy sauce, sweet chilli or sriracha

method: Microwave the veg bag first, as the packet says; it takes longest and stays hot while sealed.
Peel the rice cup lid back a little and microwave it for about 2 minutes.
Drain the tuna well by pressing the lid down on it, so the bowl isn't watery.
In a microwave-safe bowl: rice, then veg, then tuna, with the cheese on top.
Microwave 45–60 seconds to melt the cheese and warm the tuna, then season.
tips: The home microwave is a Kmart Anko, probably 700–900 W. Packet times are often for 1,000–1,100 W: multiply by about 1.4 (3.5 min at 1,100 W ≈ 5 min), then add 30 seconds at a time until hot.
Tuna is already cooked: warm it briefly, as overheating dries it out and makes it smell.
To make it a bigger meal, add rice cups: carbs are usually what's left at the end of the day.
Tinned tuna water carries some salt; a small bump on the scale the next morning is water, not fat.

variations.name: 1 rice cup, 3 tins, veg, cheese
variations.changes: As written, with the cheese, no mayo or sauce.
